gui/api.ts lines 1891-1892: the file uses `export type { StoreListItem } from '...'` (re-export) followed by `import type { StoreListItem } from '...'` (local binding), both from the same source. This is idiomatic-but-verbose TypeScript — `export type { X } from '...'` does not create a local binding, so both declarations are necessary when you need both a local use and a re-export. The marginally cleaner alternative is `import type { StoreListItem } from '...'` followed by `export type { StoreListItem }` (without the `from`). Not blocking — current form is valid.
